$comment: Licenses that may ship with Hubium LMS (AGPL-3.0). Change this file only after checking that a license is compatible; record reviewed one-off cases under exceptions.

production.description: Packages the running application loads (pnpm licenses list --prod): permissive licenses and copyleft that combines with AGPL-3.0.

tooling.description: Build, test and database tools (all other installed packages). They ship in images next to the application, not linked into it, so licenses that do not combine with AGPL-3.0 are fine as long as they allow redistribution.
